summary: Restored fast ResQ reserving-class migration through the ArcRho Server worker pool.
details: Migration-generated datasets now use the same shared request folder and running data-engine instances as the Excel add-in, with requests published as a batch so available workers can process them concurrently.
The import stops before connecting to ResQ or changing project data when no fresh data-engine heartbeat is available, and shows an explicit alert.

Worker-aware migration requests use an optional status sidecar so new workers can report calculation failures without an error CSV being accepted as a completed dataset; already-running legacy workers remain compatible and their recognizable error rows are rejected.
Maintained macros can suspend per-line tracing around trusted migration work while retaining cancellation checks and activity-based timeout protection.
Generated datasets skip unused ResQ value extraction, processing provenance is computed once per import, and final sidecar graph enrichment reuses one physical dataset inventory.
